exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: exact Silent Storm interface diffuse6658, original complete1024x1024 painting.
Input: original storedRGB artwork, NEAREST source-only wholecanvas enlargement2x to2048x2048. This is the sole edit target and exact UV/material reference. Original source alpha is preserved separately by the final game packer.
Request: faithfully resolve the existing quiet painted paper into finer HD detail while preserving the complete source normalized UV and its exact pattern/stain scale. Return the WHOLE square canvas edge-to-edge, including the large original black TOP and black margins. No change to overall shape, framing, spacing, relative intensity or broad shades. Keep the source restrained smooth aged paper and plain gray placeholder fields; refine pixels without creating conspicuous new fibre, gritty pits, shiny rims or extra surface pattern.
Exact invariants: the lower wide folded/stacked blank paper form has THREE main vertical fields. The left has EIGHT original horizontal blank rows, arranged FIVE upper and THREE lower, each with its existing paired dark end fields. The middle is ONE large plain solid dark-gray rectangle with its existing straight outline, never a photo or decorated texture. The right has SIX original rows, TWO upper and FOUR lower, each with its paired dark-brown end fields, plus the existing separating outlined blank horizontal band between those groups. Preserve every original horizontal/vertical line at the exact source location, including the thin existing double outer outlines, lower paper stack/fold protrusions, and every black margin. Preserve counts of all source rows and dark end fields exactly. All gray, brown and black placeholder interiors stay as plain as in the source; no content inside them. No invented labels, small squares, tabs or symbols.
Material: exact source muted paper shades, original weak stains/folds/edge shading and very fine low-contrast grain. Broad stains remain source-positioned and source-sized. Never relight; numeric brightness correction will follow separately. HD refinement should remain quiet at original viewing scale.
Constraints: no crop, zoom, recenter, shift, rotate, padding, extra whitespace/frame, bounding-box fit, repacking, compositing, source overlay or new scene. No new row/grid/line/hole, text/numeral/glyph/logo/flag/photo/portrait/close-mark, fold/tear/clip/bolt, scratches, decorative curl or flecks. Do not accentuate relative borders or roughen the surface. Output opaque completeRGB on the original black canvas; generated alpha does not replace original alpha. Only refine the existing original painting.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Source RGBA to native stored RGB only. Wholecanvas NEAREST resize to recorded helper_size. Aspect>3 uses exact1536x512 source-only fullcanvas affine3:1; all others native aspect nearest2x. Root-authorized inverse entire raw to original4x. NO crop/padding/rotation/BBox/UV fitting/inpainting/unpremultiplication/art insertion. Original source alpha separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: Entire raw LANCZOS to exact original.width*4,original.height*4; no crop/padding/autoBBox/composite.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
